A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the ICARE trial is the first randomized controlled trial to demonstrate a statistically significant and clinically meaningful improvement in motor recovery in the upper extremity following stroke.

the results of the ICARE study suggest that a task-oriented approach to rehabilitation is more efficacious than a traditional approach for improving upper extremity function in individuals with stroke.

the ICARE program is an efficacious intervention that can be delivered by therapists who are not experts in stroke rehabilitation and can improve the recovery of motor function in the upper extremity of people with chronic motor impairment following stroke.
